practiceGreens.source: the putting green beside the clubhouse, MEASURED: excess green 109 inside against 78 in its own 3-8 m collar (contrast 31, where the nine surveyed greens read 3-45 with a median 18) and laser-flat at 0.17 m over 5x5 against their median 0.18; the green grower accepts 604 m2 here (set B, solidity 0.965, centroid 1.8 m off the centre). Radius from that area (trace-practice.mjs 2026-09-05)
practiceGreens.shapeStatus: Circle derived from detected area; boundary is not a traced green contour

drivingRange.source: the practice field east of the 1st, MEASURED as the open ground the model does not otherwise claim: not forest in the tree-cover raster, not water, not inside a green/fairway/tee/bunker ring, not within 25 m of a hole line, not within 8 m of a road, track or path — the component containing a seed read off the OWNER’S OWN MARK on the app overhead (converted through the clubhouse, parking and manor footprints visible in the same frame), opened 2 m, closed 3 m, simplified to 2 m. 40,163 m2 over x 504-715, z -432..-172, bounded by the estate track north, the treeline east, the 1st’s corridor west and the wood south (trace-practice.mjs 2026-09-05). It replaces a 6,541 m2 strip of DORMANT ground between the 9th and the 1st, 180 m west, which an earlier pass classified as the range because it was the most striking thing in the capture and the eye-traced ring lay near it: a dormant strip here is a hayfield. The club’s own overview agrees with the owner — registered on its nine numbered discs the map is rotated -149 deg, and its DRIVING RANGE and OVNINGSOMRADE labels then fall east and south-east of KLUBBHUS.
drivingRange.baysStatus: Unresolved: raw bench candidate [600.5,-446.2] was rejected by reviewed surroundings-traces.json
drivingRange.baysNote: NOT measured: a tee line is a built platform, but this pasture is flat everywhere (5,719 of 11,822 cells at the north end read flat to 0.12 m over 5x5, 3,787 at the south), so the bench test that worked on the dormant strip identifies nothing here. The engine’s own rule stands — the bays are the end of the field you walk to from the clubhouse, which is the north end, and the shot line runs south down the field away from the clubhouse and the 1st.
